title: The Crossroads
subtitle: maxCompletableDependents: 1
description: Three roads lead away from the alley's end and only one of them
can be walked: `maxCompletableDependents: 1` lets at most one of
this quest's direct dependents complete -- the others stay locked
for good, the moment the first is done.
It is the cap on a fan-out, where `exclusiveGroup` is a named pact
between siblings -- the counting-house's patrons and the hunt's
one hook are that form. Use whichever reads better: a quest that
closes its own roads, or siblings that close each other.
